svg.text: Settings and generated replacements · where each inspector comes from
A setting prepares a proposal. Ordinary manual editing never needs a second “keep” action.
Click Ramp settings → change Color intensity
Selecting a candidate opens its token inspector.
Current and New stay equal while kept.
This token is Manual and Protected.
References will resolve to the new value.
Choosing once updates New in the shared draft.
It does not save. Apply below saves the ramp.
After “Use generated value once”, New becomes the candidate and the footer includes that replacement. Nothing is saved until Apply.
